head_coach.name: Hugo Broos
head_coach.play_style_summary: A hybrid, high-energy system focusing on a disciplined double-pivot midfield, fluid winger movements, and quick transitions, with the flexibility to occasionally switch to a back-three setup depending on the opposition.

key_players.name: Lyle Foster
key_players.performance_stats: Serves as Bafana Bafana's primary goal threat and spearheads the attack, utilizing his physicality and top-flight European experience.

key_players.name: Teboho Mokoena
key_players.performance_stats: The core engine in the central double-pivot, responsible for dictating tempo, breaking up opposition plays, and taking penalties.

key_players.name: Relebohile Mofokeng
key_players.performance_stats: A highly creative young talent who brings exceptional dribbling, pace, and agility to open up dense defensive blocks.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Excluded from the preliminary World Cup squad while recovering from a knee injury.
Facing a race against time and remains highly doubtful due to an injury picked up in club action.
Sidelined and ruled out of contention due to an ongoing long-term injury recovery.
